courses.subject: HMNR
courses.title: Introduction to Human Rights and Global Justice
courses.description: Explores where human rights come from and what they mean by integrating them into a history of modern society, from the conquest of the Americas and the origins of the Enlightenment, to the Holocaust and the contemporary human rights regime.

courses.subject: HMNR
courses.title: Human Rights II: Contemporary Issues
courses.description: Interdisciplinary discussion that outlines the structure and functioning of the contemporary human rights regime, and then delves into the relationship between selected human rights protections—against genocide, torture, enslavement, political persecution, etc.—and their violation, from early Cold War to the present.
